GitHub - nianticlabs/spz: File format for 3D Gaussian splats. About 10x ...
.spz is a file format for compressed 3D gaussian splats. This directory contains a C++ library for saving and loading data in the .spz format. spz encoded splats are typically around 10x smaller than the corresponding .ply files, with minimal visual differences between the two.
